Crude Oil Prices Rise Amid Declining US Inventories

Crude oil futures saw an increase on Wednesday morning, with Brent futures rising as industry data from the US indicated a decline in crude oil inventories. This rise in oil prices coincided with GIFT Nifty jumping 1% as crude oil prices tested the $90 per barrel mark.
